clips.title: The story
paras: In Loch Modan, Strange Smelling Powder has raised alarm during an inquiry into sabotage. Chief Engineer Hinderweir suspects an explosive and seeks an expert's judgment.

Strange Smelling Powder was found amid signs of sabotage against Loch Modan's infrastructure. Chief Engineer Hinderweir fears it may be an engineered explosive, unlike the usual powder used in mining. He cannot identify its mixture or origin, and will not tamper with it himself. Even a small spark could bring disaster.
